summary: Iteration 11 testing complete: validated 3 new features — (1) 70km trajectory/approach radius, (2) Mode soirée orage fullscreen overlay, (3) shareable PNG card at /api/share/card.png. All 3 features work end-to-end. Backend 7/8 tests pass (1 minor failure: Cache-Control header stripped by ingress, not a backend bug). All regression endpoints + frontend selectors remain intact.

minor.issue: Cache-Control set by FastAPI as 'public, max-age=60' but response arriving at client is 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate' — the preview Kubernetes ingress/proxy is overriding the header. Backend code is correct (server.py L205). This is an infrastructure behaviour, not a code bug.

action_items: (Optional) If Cache-Control 'public, max-age=60' matters for production, verify the production ingress does not strip it (preview env does). Not a blocker.
critical_code_review_comments: share_card.py: render_share_card is async but all Pillow/drawing work is synchronous/CPU-bound — acceptable for a 1200x630 card (~30-80ms), but consider running in asyncio.to_thread() under heavy load to avoid blocking the event loop.
share_card.py L55: fetches strikes with radius 70km and filters to last hour in Python — fine, but store.recent() already supports since_ts; could pass since_ts=now-3600 to offload filtering.

share_card.py L72: `next((x for x in vig['departements'] if x['id']=='65'), None) or vig['departements'][0]` — `or` fallback is neat but if dept 65 exists with max_level=0 it still passes (0 is falsy only if max_level field were the iterable, which it isn't, so the dict truthiness is fine). No issue.

NightStormMode.jsx: `seenTs.current` uses epoch ts as dedup key — two strikes at identical sub-second ts would be missed. Low probability given Blitzortung precision. Also on reopen, seenTs is reset in the cleanup effect (L111) so every strike on re-open counts as 'fresh' → first fetch has `seenTs.current.size === 0` guard (L91) that suppresses beep on initial load. Good.

NightStormMode.jsx: playThunderBeep creates a new AudioContext per beep and closes it 400ms later — works, but modern browsers throttle AudioContext creation and may log warnings. A singleton AudioContext instantiated on first user gesture would be cleaner.

Dashboard.jsx shareCard(): Web Share API path doesn't await the share promise before the fetch — actually it does (await navigator.share). Good. Fallback clipboard.writeText may silently fail in headless/non-HTTPS contexts, but the window.open fallback still runs. Minor: if clipboard fails and window.open is blocked by popup blocker (rare on user-initiated click), user gets nothing. Acceptable.
Dashboard.jsx L121: /api/storms/approach called with radius_km=70 as requested — matches UI max slider. Trajectory also 70km (TrajectoryLayer L27, TrajectoryBadge L22).
server.py /api/share/card.png route is simple and correct. No auth — appropriate for a shareable preview image.
Prior iter-10 gap still present: /api/storms/approach still uses naive median-split without clustering (noted in iter-10). Scope of iter-11 doesn't touch this.
